workflow_name: Open home page and verify landing content
workflow_steps: Open /; verify BookStore home page loads; verify Login and Registration/User navigation options are visible
expected_semantic_oracle: Home page should load successfully and show main navigation options.

workflow_steps: Open /Login; verify login form is displayed; verify username/password fields and submit button are visible
expected_semantic_oracle: Login page should display form controls required for user/admin login.

workflow_steps: Open /Login; submit the form without username and password
expected_semantic_oracle: Application should remain on login page or show validation/error message without opening user/admin home.

workflow_steps: Open /Login; enter invalid username and password; submit login form
expected_semantic_oracle: Application should reject invalid credentials and should not navigate to protected user/admin pages.

workflow_steps: Open /User_Registration; verify registration form is visible
expected_semantic_oracle: Registration page should show fields for creating a user account.

workflow_steps: Open /User_Registration; submit form without filling required fields
expected_semantic_oracle: Application should show validation/error behavior or remain on registration page.

workflow_name: Register new user with valid details
workflow_steps: Open /User_Registration; fill valid user details; submit registration form
expected_semantic_oracle: New user should be saved or application should show successful registration/navigation response.

workflow_steps: Open /User_Home; verify user dashboard or user view page loads
expected_semantic_oracle: User home page should load and display user navigation options.

workflow_steps: Open /User_Books; verify list/search area for books is displayed
expected_semantic_oracle: User books page should display available book browsing functionality.

workflow_steps: Open /User_Books or /user_search_Book; submit search without book name/details
expected_semantic_oracle: Application should handle empty search safely and not crash.

workflow_name: Search book with valid title keyword
workflow_steps: Open user book search page; enter a valid/common book keyword; submit search
expected_semantic_oracle: Search result page should display matching book details or safe no-result message.

workflow_name: Search book with invalid title keyword
workflow_steps: Open user book search page; enter an invalid random book keyword; submit search
expected_semantic_oracle: Application should show no matching books or remain stable without server error.

workflow_steps: Open /User_Book_Details or navigate from user book list to book details
expected_semantic_oracle: Book details page should display book information such as name, author, price, or category.

workflow_steps: Open user book details; select or enter rating; submit rating using /user_Rate_Book
expected_semantic_oracle: Application should accept rating or show safe validation behavior.

workflow_steps: Open /User_Buy_Book; verify buy book page/form is displayed
expected_semantic_oracle: Buy book page should display fields/options required for purchase.

workflow_steps: Open /User_Buy_Book; search for a book using /user_Search_Buy_Book
expected_semantic_oracle: Application should display matching book purchase option or no-result message.

workflow_name: Submit buy book form with empty details
workflow_steps: Open /User_Buy_Book; submit buy/save form without required details
expected_semantic_oracle: Application should show validation behavior or avoid saving incomplete order.

workflow_steps: Open /User_Buy_Book; fill valid book/order details; submit using /user_Save_Buy_Book
expected_semantic_oracle: Application should save order or show successful purchase/order response.

workflow_steps: Open /Order_Details; verify order details page loads
expected_semantic_oracle: Order details page should display order list/details or safe empty state.

workflow_name: User book browsing to order details end-to-end
workflow_steps: Open user home; open user books; search/select book; open buy book page; open order details
expected_semantic_oracle: Complete user workflow should navigate through book browsing, purchase, and order detail pages without application crash.

workflow_steps: Open /Admin_Home; verify admin dashboard page loads
expected_semantic_oracle: Admin home page should show admin navigation options.

workflow_steps: Open /Book_Management; verify book management options are visible
expected_semantic_oracle: Book management page should display add/delete/select operation options.

workflow_steps: Open /Book_Management; select an operation using /selectoperation
expected_semantic_oracle: Application should navigate to correct add/delete/book details operation page.

workflow_steps: Open /Book_Management; access add book operation; submit /book_Add without required fields
expected_semantic_oracle: Application should validate missing book fields or avoid adding incomplete book.

workflow_steps: Open /Book_Management; fill valid book details; submit /book_Add
expected_semantic_oracle: Application should save new book or show successful add-book response.

workflow_name: Delete book with invalid book id/details
workflow_steps: Open /Book_Management; submit /book_Delete with invalid book id/details
expected_semantic_oracle: Application should handle invalid delete safely without crash.

workflow_name: Delete book with valid book id/details
workflow_steps: Open /Book_Management; submit /book_Delete with valid existing book details
expected_semantic_oracle: Application should delete selected book or show successful delete response.

workflow_steps: Open /Book_Details; verify book details/admin list page loads
expected_semantic_oracle: Admin book details page should display available book records or safe empty state.

workflow_steps: Open /User_Details; verify user details page loads
expected_semantic_oracle: Admin user details page should display user records or safe empty state.

workflow_steps: Open /Admin_Order_Details; verify admin order details page loads
expected_semantic_oracle: Admin order details page should display order records or safe empty state.
